correctness.rationale: A transitive Z²-action is uniquely specified by its stabilizer ⟨(a,0),(−b,d)⟩; its centralizer is the regular translation group of size ad. In the weighted labeled count for the tag, choosing the other ad−1 labels and multiplying by (ad−1)! transitive actions and (n−ad)!Z_{n−ad} for the complement cancels to (n−1)!Z_{n−ad}. Multiplying by θ and dividing by n!Z_n gives the per-triple formula. The Euler product follows from Σ_{j≥1}σ₁(j)z^j/j=−Σ_{r≥1}log(1−z^r). For h(t)=log Fθ(e^{−t}), the Riemann sum for x/(e^x−1) gives h′(t)=−β²/t²+Oθ(t⁻¹); the analogous integrable function x²e^x/(e^x−1)² gives h″(t)∼2β²/t³, and the third derivative is Oθ(t⁻⁴) on the contour by the nonnegative log coefficients. At t=β/√n the linear error and cubic remainder on |φ|≤t^{3/2}log(1/t) tend uniformly to zero. The first-harmonic geometric sum is comparable to φ²/[t(t²+φ²)] for |φ|≤π, so the complementary arc is negligible on the Gaussian scale. With the real eta estimate this yields the stated prefactor and uniform coefficient ratio on j≤M√n. For each d the a-grid has mesh d/√n and the twist count is a; the limiting mass density is θx e^{−βx}/d². The sum of its integrals is θζ(2)/β²=1, establishing tightness including at 0. On every fixed-d compact x-interval away from 0, a→∞ and the twist grid converges uniformly against continuous tests. This proves the three-way product limit on the stated space.
residual_risks: The coefficient ratio and convergence are for fixed positive θ. No moving-θ uniformity or error rate is established. The finite check is corroboration, not the asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: The tagged orbit is the typical component seen from a point of the random action, complementary to a count of all components. The theorem resolves both its diverging size and the simultaneously tight, arithmetic number of σ-cycles; it also establishes independence of the continuum twist. In particular it identifies exactly which distributions change with θ, a feature neither a Gamma size marginal nor the total-count CLT can show.
residual_risks: Only two ordered generators and a single tag are covered. The generality of the prior census is not part of the value claim.
